verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Wise Business can make business payments from a Wise account, including via API (wise-docs-6, wise-docs-2), and the llms.txt describes 'domestic and cross-border payments tools' (wise-probe-1). However, ACH appears only as a way to fund batch transfers via direct debit (wise-docs-23), not as an outbound rail to vendors, and domestic wire sending is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of outbound domestic ACH payments to vendors, outbound domestic wire support, vendor/payee payment workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
